description.text: Deck Build Box Battle Partners, released on 24 January 2025 with the Battle Partners expansion: ten packs of it and 171 cards of 53 kinds for building decks, cards that had done well in official tournaments such as Fezandipiti ex and Night Stretcher, with 12 of each of the eight basic Energy. Some of them are printed differently from the cards they reprint. A card box with four dividers came with it. This set holds the 45 kinds besides basic Energy.
